name: Type
description: Type of asset, according to the definitions in Section 5.5

name: Name
description: Name used by technical staff to refer to the asset; might be left blank for many lower level assets

name: Asset ID
description: Unique code used to identify a particular asset in the asset register (see Section 5.2 for further details)

name: Description
description: Additional information to help staff locate or identify an asset

name: Photo
description: Photo of the asset

name: Parent asset ID
description: Asset ID of the asset that is a parent to this asset (see Section 5.3 for further details)

name: Location
description: Geographic location of the asset on the surface of the Earth; may be a point, line, or polygon

name: Location precision
description: Estimated uncertainty in the geographic coordinates, expressed as a distance

name: Elevation
description: Height above the surface of a defined ellipsoid model of the earth’s surface, such as WGS84, or the local mean sea level; a consistent reference system should be used for all assets within a water system

name: Elevation precision
description: Estimated uncertainty in the measurement of the elevation

name: Administrative region
description: Name that describes the administrative geography of the location; multiple levels may be separated by commas starting with the most general area, for example: Region, District, Municipality

name: Coverage area
description: Geographical area where the water system or service provides coverage or is legally obligated to serve

name: Sector
description: Name for a sub-region of the coverage area that is defined by geography or the physical layout of the distribution network

name: Route
description: Name or number of the meter reading route, which defines those meters that are assigned to a particular staff member or team

name: Address
description: Physical address or postal address where the asset is located; in the case of piped connections, the address of the customer

name: Urban-rural classification
description: Degree of urbanization, as defined by national standards or the Degree of Urbanisation method (OECD 2021)

name: Community
description: Name of the community, town, or neighborhood where a water system or facility is located

name: Accessible by road
description: Asset can be accessed by vehicles using a nearby road

name: Perimeter fence or wall installed
description: Fence or wall exists to provide physical security for the asset

name: Level 1
description: Highest or most general level of categorization to which the asset belongs under the asset hierarchy

name: Level 2
description: Second highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 3
description: Third highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 4
description: Fourth highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 5
description: Fifth highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 6
description: Sixth highest level of hierarchy

name: Level 7
description: Lowest level of hierarchy

name: Status
description: How the asset is currently being used or operated

name: Condition
description: The physical or structural integrity of the asset

name: Functional status
description: Most recent observation of whether a water system or water point is working as designed

name: Current replacement cost (USD)
description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to replace the asset at the current time; this value requires regular updating based on depreciation and current market conditions; also known as CRC

name: Expected useful life
description: Number of years that the asset is estimated to function after installation if it is well maintained; also known as EUL

name: Probability of failure
description: Measure of the likelihood of a failure happening at any point in time, based on an analysis of the potential failure modes of the asset

name: Consequence of failure
description: Measure of the direct and indirect costs of asset failure, which may include financial, environmental, and societal costs

name: Asset risk
description: Business or organizational risk of asset failure, usually calculated from the probability and consequence of failure

name: Original cost (USD)
description: Total price paid (in US Dollars) to initially acquire an asset

name: Current rehabilitation cost (USD)
description: Cost (in US Dollars) that would be incurred to rehabilitate the asset at the current time

name: Manufacturer
description: Name of the business that produced or sold the asset

name: Model
description: Manufacturer’s designation for the particular model of the asset

name: Serial number
description: Unique identifying number or code assigned to a particular asset by the manufacturer or vendor, usually stamped or printed on the asset

name: Additional technical details
description: Any other technical information about the asset that is not captured by the attributes of this standard

name: Installation date
description: Calendar date when the asset was installed or purchased, which begins the period of useful life

name: Installed by
description: Name of the company or organization that originally installed or purchased the system or facility

name: Funded by
description: Name of the funding authority, lender, or donor who funded the purchase of the system or facility

name: Rehabilitation date
description: Date of most recent work done to restore the asset to its original level of service and extend its life

name: Last service date
description: Date of most recent service or maintenance performed

name: Rehabilitated by
description: Name of the company or organization that performed the most recent rehabilitation of the asset

name: Service interval
description: Recommended interval at which service or routine maintenance should be performed on the asset

name: Upstream asset
description: Asset ID of the upstream asset that supplies water to this asset
applicability: Type: Pump, Tank, Treatment, Meter, Valve, Hydrant, Junction, Sampling point, Water point, Pipe

name: Nominal diameter
description: An approximate measurement of the internal diameter of a pipe, conduit, pump, or junction, which is used to classify according to standard sizes

name: Pipe length
description: Total length of pipe in a given section or run for use in hydraulic calculations and modeling

name: Material
description: Material of construction for pipes, junctions, valves, meters, and other liquid conduits
applicability: Type: Meter, Valve, Hydrant, Junction, Pipe

name: Minor loss coefficient
description: Dimensionless coefficient that can be used to account for the head loss associated with turbulence in bends, junctions, meters, and valves

name: Roughness coefficient
description: Dimensionless coefficient used to account for friction losses in flowing pipes in either the Hazen-Williams or Darcy-Weisbach head loss equation

name: Primary contact name
description: Individual or office responsible for management or administration of the water system or water point

name: Primary contact position
description: Title or role in the organization of the primary contact

name: Primary contact phone number
description: Phone number of the primary contact

name: Secondary contact name
description: Additional individual who may be contacted if the primary contact is not available

name: Secondary contact position
description: Title or role of the secondary contact

name: Secondary contact phone number
description: Phone number of the secondary contact

name: Date updated
description: Calendar date of the most recent update made to any attribute

name: Date inspected
description: Calendar date of the most recent inspection or audit of the asset, as defined by organizational asset management policies

name: Alternate ID
description: Optional additional identification code or number that is used by other data systems or organizations to track the asset

name: Import code
description: Identification code for an asset that was assigned by an external database or asset management registry, used to maintain backwards traceability for assets that have been imported

name: Water system type
description: Categorization of the system as a distribution network or a point source

name: Network type
description: Categorization of piped networks as branching or grid style

name: Management type
description: Type of organization that manages the operations, maintenance, and finances of the water supply system

name: Number of households in service area
description: Total number of households within the area that a service provider is legally mandated to offer services to

name: Number of households currently served
description: Number of households with a functional connection or currently able to receive service (includes households with inactive, intermittent, or cut off services, if service could be re-established)

name: System or network diagram
description: Photograph of a recent map or diagram showing the location of water supply and distribution infrastructure

name: Total production of system
description: Amount of water that the system is able to supply, within current resource and design constraints

name: Process area type
description: Optional label used to categorize process areas

name: Source type
description: Characterization of the source based on type of technology

name: Source meter installed
description: Meter is installed at the source to measure total flow

name: Water quality tested
description: Water quality testing has been performed at this source

name: Date of most recent sample
description: Calendar date of most recent water quality sampling at this source

name: Name of water body
description: Name of the water body supplying the source, if one exists

name: Source pressure
description: Pressure, or head, of the water leaving the source

name: Nominal flow
description: Typical or rated volumetric water flow rate that the source provides when operating as designed

name: Minimum flow
description: Minimum Flow rate rate that the source provides during the driest period of the year

name: Maximum flow
description: Maximum Flow rate rate that the source can accommodate during periods of high use or source water availability

name: Well depth
description: Depth below the ground surface to which the well was drilled, driven, or dug; in boreholes, this may differ from the casing depth

name: Well diameter
description: Inside diameter of the well; in boreholes, this is the drilled diameter, which will differ from the casing diameter

name: Static water level
description: Water level below the ground measured when no water is being taken from the aquifer by pumping

name: Dynamic water level
description: Water level below the ground measured when a pump is operating

name: Groundwater temperature
description: Temperature of groundwater in the aquifer or discharged by a pump

name: Apron installed
description: Apron is installed to protect the well from back-contamination by surface water and to channel drainage away from the well

name: Monitoring well
description: Well is primarily used for monitoring water levels and/or water quality rather than for water production

name: Spring box present
description: Protective brick, masonry, or concrete structure is installed around the spring so that water flows directly out through a pipe

name: Spring box length
description: Length of the longest side of the spring box, measured from the outside

name: Spring box width
description: Length of the shortest side of the spring box, measured from the outside

name: Spring box depth
description: Length of the vertical dimension of the spring box, measured from the outside

name: Overflow pipe present
description: Pipe is installed near the top of the spring box to allow water to exit when box is full

name: Drain pipe present
description: Pipe is installed near the bottom of the spring box to direct the flow from the spring

name: Casing diameter
description: Inside diameter of the well casing

name: Depth of casing
description: Depth below the ground to which the casing is installed; below this depth there would normally be a screen installed

name: Casing material
description: Well casing material

name: Screen length
description: Length of the well screen, which is a sleeve with slots, holes, gauze, or wire wrap installed below the casing to allow entry of water and prevent entry of sand or other large particles

name: Pump position
description: Depth below ground to the top of a submersible pump

name: Photo of well log
description: One or more photographs of the well log, or drilling log, which usually contains a record of the soil and rock formations (lithology) encountered during the drilling of the well; may also contain data on the casing and backfill used to reinforce the well

name: Pump type
description: Description of the pump mechanism or operating principle

name: Pump diameter
description: Maximum outer diameter of a submersible pump

name: Pump power rating
description: Power consumed by a pump operating under normal pressure and flow conditions, as defined by the manufacturer

name: Pump motor configuration
description: Whether the motor and pump should be tracked as a single asset or as separate assets; in cases where the motor is separate from pump, this generally means that motors are interchangeable between pumps of a similar design

name: Pump motor voltage type
description: Type of electrical power required by the pump
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Pump motor voltage
description: Normal operating voltage of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Pump motor max current
description: Current drawn by the pump when operating at the maximum or full load power rating
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Pump motor max power
description: Maximum, or full load power rating of the pump, as recommended by the manufacturer
applicability: Pump motor configuration: Integrated with pump

name: Design flow
description: Flow rate of the pump required by the system design under normal operating conditions; should be within the acceptable flow range as defined by the pump curve

name: Design head
description: Head, or pressure, shown on the pump curve at the design flow rate

name: Maximum flow (Q-max)
description: Maximum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

name: Head at maximum flow (H-min)
description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the maximum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the minimum head

name: Minimum flow (Q-min)
description: Minimum possible flow rate shown on the pump curve

name: Head at minimum flow (H-Max)
description: Total head, or pressure, that corresponds to the minimum flow rate on the pump curve; also referred to as the maximum head

name: NPSH-R
description: Net positive suction head required (or minimum) by the suction side of the pump in order to prevent cavitation and evaporation (flashing)

name: Tank type
description: Characterization of the tank design

name: Tank material
description: Main material of construction used in the tank

name: Tank volume
description: Useful volume of the tank which can be supplied from the minimum to the maximum water levels.

name: Tank shape
description: Basic shape or form factor of the tank

name: Tank diameter
description: Diameter of the base of a cylindrical tank

name: Tank height
description: Distance from the bottom to the top of the tank, measured from outside

name: Tank length
description: Length of the longest side of the base of a rectangular tank

name: Tank width
description: Length of the shortest side of the base of a rectangular tank

name: Height of tank bottom
description: Distance from the ground level to the bottom of the inside of the tank; negative values are used for depths below the ground

name: Minimum water level
description: Minimum water level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the outlet or the minimum height allowed by a filling control

name: Maximum water level
description: Maximum water level allowed in the tank, measured from the tank bottom; this may be the height of the overflow pipe or the maximum height allowed by a filling control

name: Filling control installed
description: Control is installed to ensure a desired range of tank fill levels

name: Type of filling control
description: Method or device used to maintain the water level in the tank by controlling the influent or effluent flow rate

name: Fill level indicator installed
description: Device is installed that provides a visual or electronic measurement of the fill level

name: Power type
description: Categorization of the power generating device based on design or principles of operation

name: Rated power output
description: Power output that can be sustained for long periods of time; for generators this is the continuous power rating

name: Maximum power output
description: Power output that can be provided for short periods of time in response to surges in demand; for generators, sometimes referred to as the standby or intermittent power rating

name: Nominal voltage
description: Voltage assigned to a system or circuit of a given voltage class for the purpose of convenient designation; the actual operating voltage may vary above or below this value

name: Rated voltage
description: Maximum voltage at which the power system can be operated within thermal and safety limits

name: Maximum current
description: Maximum safe current, or starting current, that can be supplied for a short period of time

name: Type of current
description: Mode of transmission for electrical current (AC/DC)

name: Frequency of current
description: Frequency at which the voltage rises to a peak, reverses, and rises to a peak again
applicability: Type of current: Single phase AC, Three phase AC

name: Generator fuel
description: Type of fuel required by the generator

name: Generator apparent power
description: Product of the voltage and current provided in an AC power system, which does not account for the reactive power required by inductive loads in the circuit; sometimes referred to by its most common unit of measurement: kVA
applicability: Type of current: Single phase AC, Three phase AC

name: Engine cooling system
description: Type of cooling system used by the generator engine

name: PV panel type
description: Photovoltaic panel type

name: Total number of PV panels
description: Total number of photovoltaic panels installed in the power system

name: Treatment type
description: Categorization of treatment process by treatment method or objective

name: Chlorine type
description: Chemical form of chlorine used in a treatment process

name: Dosing method
description: Method used to add chlorine to water to be treated
applicability: Chlorination type: Sodium hypochlorite (bleach), Calcium hypochlorite, Chloramine

name: Meter ID
description: Identification number of code used by the service provider to identify the meter

name: Meter type
description: Type of metering performed: bulk metering of the distribution network versus domestic or commercial metering

name: Meter design
description: Design or operating principle of the meter

name: Minimum measurable flow rate
description: Lowest flow rate that can be measured by the meter

name: Meter measurement type
description: Type of measurement displayed by the meter (total volume, flow rate, or both)

name: Electrical type
description: Type of electrical asset

name: Electrical power device type
description: Classification of electrical power device based on purpose or mode of operation

name: Valve type
description: Purpose or operating principle of a valve

name: Date of last actuation
description: Most recent date that the valve was actuated to prevent degradation and verify functionality

name: Hydrant type
description: Type of hydrant design

name: Sampling point type
description: Type of facility that allows for collection of water quality samples

name: Analyzer type
description: Short description of the type or purpose of the analyzer

name: Perimeter type
description: Type of perimeter design

name: Perimeter total length
description: Total length of the entire perimeter that is being defined as an asset

name: Perimeter height
description: Typical or minimum height of the perimeter

name: Perimeter setback distance
description: Typical or minimum distance from the perimeter from the structure or equipment it is designed to protect

name: Water point type
description: Type of technology used to access water

name: Agricultural use
description: Water point provides water that is primarily for agricultural use

name: Livestock use
description: Water point provides water that is primarily for use by livestock

name: Meter installed
description: Meter is installed at this water point

name: Number of taps
description: Total number of taps, such as faucets or spigots, available at a kiosk or public tap
applicability: Water point type: Kiosk, Public tap

name: Kiosk tank installed
description: Presence of a tank at the kiosk for storing water during planned or unplanned outages

name: Connection type
description: Categorization of piped connections based on the type of user or customer

name: Connection diameter
description: The diameter of pipe used for the customer connection

name: Other vertical asset type
description: Description or categorization of the other type of vertical asset

name: Pipe type
description: Category of water supply pipe type

name: Pipe color
description: Color or pattern painted on pipe to designate the type of fluid

name: Nominal pressure
description: Numerical designation of design pressure that is a convenient round number for reference purposes

name: Pipe depth below ground
description: Depth of the pipe below the local ground surface
